scope: 2 Chronicles 36 and Ezra 1–10: 303 verses in 11 complete chapters; first checkpoint of requested larger batch.
decisions: Preserve Aramaic document registers, claims and brutal royal penalties in their speakers’ voices.
Retain Ezra 5:4 we, 6:22 king of Assyria, and the written/read name choices in the pinned source.
Keep Ezra’s itemized and overall counts even where they differ; no harmonization with Nehemiah.
Keep holy seed, tent peg, slavery, the wives and children affected by expulsion, and uncertainty in 10:44.
Source-based rereading corrected Ezra 1:7 from singular god to gods while recording the alternative sense.
companion_impact: Revised quotations and chapter bindings need later reconciliation; Companion branch not changed.
